item.title: Vinyl Sales Rise for 19th Consecutive Year
item.description: Variety: U.S. vinyl sales increased for the 19th consecutive year, growing by +8.6% to 47.9 million units. Total U.S. Physical Album Sales increased by +6.5%. In contrast, U.S. Digital Album Sales dropped by -15.9%. 2025 marks the first time in the U.S. consumption era (2014+) that two individual albums earned 5m+ units in a single […]

item.description: 311 have announced a new batch of shows leading up to their 311 day celebration.
